title: A canary that cannot run fails adopt instead of reporting skipped
body:
Why: #690 canary returns 'skipped' (exit 0) for no test file, an unsupported language or no commit; D1 says the gate fails closed and proves itself.
Outcome: adopt fails on a skipped canary unless --no-canary records the operator's decline; a repo with no tests gets a clear message naming what to add.
